grounding_policy: Each gold answer must be supportable from one historical ticket resolution in fru_us_1000_100/service_queries.csv AND one manual fact already in retail-manual-qa-test-suite.json for the same model. Do not invent parts or temperatures.

questions.question: On a GNE27JYMFS the touch panel is unresponsive (same complaint as a resolved Omaha case that showed FRU-E108). What did that case do, and when does the user guide say the door alarm beeps?
questions.answer: The resolved case power-cycled the display board and updated firmware. When the door alarm is enabled, it sounds if either door stays open for more than 2 minutes; closing the door stops the beeping.

questions.question: A GNE27JYMFS has warm spots on the upper refrigerator shelves after a Costco load (Long Beach case, no fault code in the short symptom). What was the resolution, and what factory refrigerator and freezer presets does the top-control guide list?
questions.answer: The case cleared a blocked air damper and recalibrated the temperature sensors. Factory presets are 37°F (2.8°C) for the refrigerator and 0°F (−17.8°C) for the freezer.

questions.question: My GNE27JYMFS keeps freezing the ice cubes into one solid clump, and the food sometimes feels warm even though the app reports normal temperatures. What should a technician check or repair to stop this, and where is the XWFE filter housing located?
questions.answer: The repair adjusted the freezer temperature and replaced the bin auger seal. The XWFE filter housing is in the back upper-right corner of the refrigerator compartment.

questions.question: KRFF507HPS ice-maker housing is leaking and the service menu showed FRU-E100 (Raleigh). What parts work fixed it, and what cold-water pressure does the guide require for the dispenser and ice maker?
questions.answer: The case replaced the fill-tube heater and tightened the water inlet valve. Required household cold-water pressure is 35–120 psi (241–827 kPa).

questions.question: A KRFF507HPS in Kansas City stopped making cubes and showed FRU-E109. What did service do, and what outlet and circuit does the guide require?
questions.answer: Service cleared a jammed auger and reset the ice-maker module. The refrigerator needs a grounded 3-prong outlet on 115 V, 60 Hz AC with a fused 15- or 20-amp circuit, and must not use an extension cord or adapter.

questions.question: KRFF507HPS French doors sit uneven and scrape (Kansas City, FRU-E107). What adjustment was recorded, and how often should the water filter be replaced according to the guide?
questions.answer: The case adjusted the hinge cams and synchronized the door heights. Replace the water filter when the status indicates replacement or at least every 6 months, and sooner if water or ice-maker flow decreases noticeably.

questions.question: RF28K9070SG water is pooling under the crisper drawers and a technician confirmed FRU-E101. What was installed, and what freezer temperatures can the Freezer button select?
questions.answer: Service cleared the defrost drain tube and installed a heater-wire kit. The Freezer button selects from 5°F (−15°C) down to −8°F (−23°C).

questions.question: The water dispenser on my RF28K9070SG has slowed to a trickle and the display showed FRU-E103. What should a technician check or replace, and what room-temperature range is safe for operating the refrigerator?
questions.answer: The case replaced a clogged inline filter and flushed the water line. The allowed room temperature is 50–110°F (10–43°C).

questions.question: RF28K9070SG has warm spots on the upper shelves and diagnostic FRU-E105 (Columbus). What sensor work was done, and how do you turn off Control Lock?
questions.answer: The case cleared a blocked air damper and recalibrated the temperature sensors. Press and hold Lighting/Control Lock for 3 seconds to deactivate the lock.

questions.question: RF28K9070SG compressor area hums and food feels warm; the service menu showed FRU-E104 (Atlanta). What was replaced, and when does the door alarm sound?
questions.answer: The unit was leveled, condenser mounts were tightened, and the start relay was replaced. If a door remains open more than 2 minutes, the alarm sounds and its indicator blinks.

questions.question: After a grocery haul the top shelves of my GE French-door fridge stay warmer than the rest even though I did not change the setpoint. A similar resolved visit recalibrated sensors. What mechanical part did they clear, and if I also just hooked up the ice maker how long might the first ice take?
questions.answer: They cleared a blocked air damper and recalibrated the temperature sensors. A newly installed refrigerator may take 12 to 24 hours to begin making ice.

questions.question: The door display on my GNE27JYMFS no longer responds when I press it. What component should a technician reset or repair, and what cold-water pressure does the ice maker need?
questions.answer: They power-cycled the display board and updated firmware. The cold-water line should supply 25–120 psi (172–827 kPa).

questions.question: Cubes from my GE ice bin taste off and a past case replaced a seal on the auger after changing the freezer setpoint. Should I keep the first batches after the water line is cleared, and what seal did that case replace?
questions.answer: No. Throw away the first few batches of ice to clear the water line. That case replaced the bin auger seal (and adjusted the freezer temperature).

questions.question: Water is dripping from the ice-maker cavity on a KitchenAid French-door and cooling feels weak. A Raleigh case with FRU-E100 tightened one valve. Which heater did they replace, and should the ice maker stay on before the water line is connected?
questions.answer: They replaced the fill-tube heater and tightened the water inlet valve. Turn the ice maker OFF until the water is connected.

questions.question: My KitchenAid stopped dropping cubes after I packed the freezer. A Kansas City case reset a module. What else did they clear in the ice path, and what is the required cold-water pressure?
questions.answer: They cleared a jammed auger and reset the ice-maker module. Household cold-water pressure should be 35–120 psi (241–827 kPa).

questions.question: There is a rattle at the back of my KitchenAid near the condenser (Philadelphia case, FRU-E106). What did they do to the fan, and what forms the seal between the two closed refrigerator doors?
questions.answer: They removed debris, lubricated the fan shaft, and replaced a worn blade. The vertically hinged seal on the left door automatically forms a seal between the two closed refrigerator doors.

questions.question: Puddles keep forming under the crisper drawers in my RF28K9070SG even though it is on a dedicated 20-amp circuit. What should a technician clear or repair, and how do I start Power Freeze?
questions.answer: They cleared the defrost drain tube and installed a heater-wire kit. Press and hold Freezer for 3 seconds.

questions.question: The water dispenser on my RF28K9070SG only trickles after I fill several jugs. What part should a technician check or replace, and what temperature range can I select with the Freezer button?
questions.answer: They replaced a clogged inline filter and flushed the water line. Freezer settings run from 5°F (−15°C) down to −8°F (−23°C).

questions.question: Food on the top shelf of my Samsung feels warm on humid days while the app looks normal. A Columbus case recalibrated sensors. What airflow part did they clear, and what temperature does FlexZone Soft Freezing use?
questions.answer: They cleared a blocked air damper and recalibrated the temperature sensors. FlexZone Soft Freezing uses 23°F (−5°C).

questions.question: My RF28K9070SG has a loud hum near the compressor and the food feels warm even though the app reports normal temperatures; the display also showed FRU-E104. After checking that the refrigerator is level, what electrical part should a technician inspect or replace, and what room-temperature range is safe for operation?
questions.answer: After leveling and tightening the condenser mounts, the start relay was replaced. The allowed ambient range is 50–110°F (10–43°C).
